items.label: 3 Modes For Tailored Comfort
items.value: Featuring a durable metal mechanism for smooth and silent operation, this recliner offers three distinct seating/lounging options. Enjoy a casual coffee in an upright position, kick back with elevated legs, or recline fully to relax your entire body

items.label: Personal Stress Reliever
items.value: This PU leather reclining chair offers a private sanctuary in your living room, office, or bedroom – ideal for unwinding after a long day or indulging in leisure activities like gaming, watching movies, or enjoying your favorite TV shows and music

items.label: Easy Cleaning
items.value: With the water-resistant faux leather upholstery, spills are no longer a concern for this recliner chair. Simply wipe away any mess with a damp cloth and mild cleaner to restore its pristine appearance in no time

items.label: Durable Wood Frame & Luxurious Comfort
items.value: Featuring a sturdy engineered wood construction, generously padded with soft fiber fill, and upholstered in soft faux leather, this recliner sofa offers both durability and comfort. With a weight capacity of 265 lb, it's ideal for unwinding and relaxing after a hectic day

items.label: Effortless Assembly
items.value: It only takes a few minutes to enjoy your new journey with this faux leather recliner! Simply attach the four legs, assemble the backrest to the seat, and you are all set to relax in style

items.label: Room Type
items.value: Bedroom, Game Recreation Room, Hallway, Home Theater, Study Room

items.label: Item Dimensions D X W X H
Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Assembly is required but very simple. This recliner comes in two parts, backrest and base part, which only takes you a few minutes to put them together and also easy to disassemble if needed.
